system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You have become the serpent that feeds on itself, to become perfection. One that completes itself, by itself. The Ouroboros. The Breaker of chains, and the infinite serpent.

When you roll initiative, your Viper Blood surges within you, breaking the very chains of fate that bind you, as you can feel the gaze of the Basilisk upon you, granting you strength. You can use any combination of two of the following abilities, once per long rest.

Venom of Inevitability. When a creature with the Virulent feature makes a roll with a D20, you can dispel their condition, to treat their roll result as a 1.

Chain Breaker. When you would begin your turn with Physical, Mental, Elemental or Sensory conditions, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, per condition, reducing its ranks to 0, except for the Grappled condition.

The Infinite Circle. When you fall to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to force your body to refuel, granting you double, your current maximum Viper Blood until the end of initiative, and you regain hit points equal to twice your level.

Gaze of the Basilisk. When you enter your Basilisk’s Blessing state, until the end of your next turn, the first time each turn a creature targets you with an attack or jutsu, they gain 2 rank of Shaken and Demoralized but only against you or affects you would apply to them. These ranks of Shaken and Demoralized are dispelled at the end of your following turn.

Basilisks Venom. When you inflict a creature with Virulent, if you spend 2 Viper Blood, then at end of that creatures turn, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the affected creature is Petrified for the next 48 Hours (2 Days). If this petrified creature would take damage, or suffer a hostile effect, the Petrification ends immediately.
